 Juventus vs. Napoli - Head-to-head record
 Napoli have enjoyed the better of recent meetings with Juventus , winning six of their last ten encounters. Juventus have recorded two victories, with the other two matches ending in draws.
 However, the Turin side have a strong home record in this fixture. Juventus have won 11 of their last 15 home meetings with Napoli and kept clean sheets in each of the last three.
 Napoli, meanwhile, have won their last seven home meetings against Juventus, highlighting how strongly this rivalry has been shaped by venue.
 Juventus also won the most recent meeting, claiming a 3-0 victory in January 2026. Napoli will be keen to respond, but their away form has been less convincing than their performances on home soil.

 Juventus - Aiming to bounce back
 Let’s take a closer look at Juventus’s current situation as they head into this fixture. We will analyse the team’s inconsistent run of form for this game against Napoli.
 Recent form
 Juventus sit eighth in Serie A after nine matches, with four wins, two draws and three defeats. Their recent performances have been inconsistent , and their latest league outing brought another setback as they lost 2-0 away to Genoa despite enjoying plenty of possession.
 That defeat followed a 2-0 win at Lecce and a 2-2 draw against Rennes in Europe. Juventus have struggled to build momentum, with their 3-0 home loss to Lazio another indication of their difficulties against stronger opposition. They now face a Napoli side that has been scoring freely in recent weeks.
 Juventus have also been dealing with a significant injury list. Zeki Çelik, Nico González, Kenan Yıldız, Khéphren Thuram, Francisco Conceição, Jeff Ekhator, Kamil Grabara and captain Manuel Locatelli are unavailable.
 Randal Kolo Muani is expected to feature up front, although his recent finishing record at home has been poor. Bremer remains an important figure at the back and has contributed two league goals this season.

 Napoli - In search of consistency
 Let’s take a closer look at Napoli’s situation. We will review the team’s current form, recent results, and standout performers for the trip to Turin.
 Recent form
 Napoli are seventh in Serie A, level on points with Juventus, and have shown plenty of attacking quality despite an inconsistent campaign. They have scored at least three goals in five of their last six matches, including a 4-1 victory over Monza on Wednesday.
 That win followed a 3-3 draw with Roma and a thrilling 4-3 Champions League victory over Bodø/Glimt. Napoli’s attack has looked dangerous, but their defensive weaknesses remain a concern . They lost 1-0 away to Venezia and suffered a 3-1 defeat at Villarreal.
 Kevin De Bruyne has scored four Serie A goals this season and remains a key attacking presence. Rasmus Højlund also ended a recent scoring drought against Monza, while Matteo Politano and Scott McTominay offer further threats going forward.
 Alessandro Buongiorno, David Neres, Costantino Favasuli, Alisson Santos, Leonardo Spinazzola and Benoît Badiashile were already unavailable before Stanislav Lobotka injured his left ankle in midweek. Massimiliano Allegri will be serving the second match of a two-game suspension.

 Predictions for Juventus vs. Napoli - Goals expected in Turin
 Napoli shows impressive attacking strength, consistently featuring in high-scoring games. Juventus, despite inconsistency, often find the net at home. Given their offensive capabilities, a match with over 3.5 total goals is a strong possibility.
 Napoli’s away form has been vulnerable, revealing defensive frailties that Juventus may exploit early. This suggests an early goal is likely, making Over 0.5 goals market in the first half an interesting market.
 Both teams share similar league records, highlighting their competitive yet inconsistent nature. Considering their attacking prowess, our main prediction is for a winner to emerge in a high-scoring encounter, backing the Double Chance 12 and Over 2.5 Goals market.
